character_facts: Othon holds the title of Baron.
Othon is associated with planet Okar in the Diamond constellation.
Othon seeks honor by joining the Mother-Coach's escort.
A secondary speaker has a humorous, exhausted tone after combat, referring to fried diodes and needing coolant.
characters_present: A small talking machine or craft speaking about its overheated diodes
continuity_links: This page follows a larger battle or ambush plan involving pre-hidden explosives.
Othon's movement into the Mother-Coach's escort suggests a transition from open battle to formal fleet integration or aftermath.
The false planet and pirate force are part of an ongoing conflict already established before this page.
dialogue_meaning: A caption explains the cause of the destruction: bombs hidden in rock fissures were triggered.
Narration says the pirate side was completely annihilated and the false planet capitulated.
Narration says Othon requested and received permission to join the Mother-Coach's escort.
A comic-relief speaker complains that its diodes are burnt out and it needs extra coolant after the battle.
A formal radio exchange confirms Othon's identity and assigns his ship a rear position in the escort.
locations: The area around ancient rocks with hidden fissures
lore_facts: The setting includes 'FB3 bombs' that can be hidden in fissures of ancient rocks.
There is a 'false planet' that can surrender as a political or military entity.
An Emperor exists as a superior authority who can grant honors and assignments.
The 'Mother-Coach' has an escort important enough to be treated as an honor post.
Othon's full title on the page is Baron Othon von Salza of planet Okar in the Diamond constellation.
plot_events: Hidden FB3 bombs planted in fissures of ancient rocks are detonated.
The detonation destroys pirate forces; wreckage and bodies are shown exploding through space.
The 'false planet' is said to be forced into surrender.
Othon asks the Emperor for the honor of joining the Mother-Coach's escort, and the request is granted.
A transmission identifies Baron Othon von Salza of planet Okar in the Diamond constellation.
Othon is instructed to take his place at the rear of the formation.
uncertainties: The exact visual identity of Othon is unclear; he may be represented by the lower-right ship rather than a visible person.
The small speaker in the lower-left panel is difficult to identify precisely; it appears to be a machine, robot, or vehicle.
'FB3' is legible, but if the scan is imperfect the bomb designation could potentially be misread.
visual_summary: A large battle image shows spacecraft and mechanical bodies being torn apart in a massive explosion. A caption explains that hidden bombs in ancient rock fissures were detonated. Below, narration states that no pirate survived and that the false planet was forced to surrender. A small, battered craft or machine speaks humorously about needing rest and coolant. In the lower-right panel, a ship receives a transmission identifying Baron Othon von Salza and is ordered to take position at the rear of a fleet.
